about_the_game:
Echoes of Fire is an intense, single-player survival game set in a frozen wilderness where warmth is your only lifeline.
Stranded among the ruins of a fallen world, you must gather resources, build fires, and outlast the endless winter.

Every decision matters—how far to explore, when to add wood to your fire, and what to risk when the wind begins to howl.

Features

  • Survive the Cold: Scavenge wood, food, and materials to maintain your fire and stave off freezing temperatures.

  • Dynamic Weather System: Face unpredictable storms, shifting winds, and whiteout blizzards that can quickly turn deadly.

  • Day–Night Cycle: Explore by daylight, then defend your fragile campfire through the long, freezing nights.

  • Base Building & Crafting: Construct makeshift shelters, expand your camp, and craft tools that improve your chances of survival.

  • Exploration & Discovery: Venture into the wild to uncover abandoned outposts, hidden relics, and traces of those who came before.

  • Atmospheric World: A minimalist, stylized art direction and immersive soundscape bring the frozen world to life.

Can you keep the fires burning long enough to uncover what remains of a world lost to the frost?

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Monterey (12.0) or later
  • Processor: Both
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU / Radeon Pro 560X or equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for smooth 1080p @ 60 FPS gameplay.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Monterey (12.0) or later
  • Processor: Both
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 GPU / Radeon Pro 5700 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Designed for smooth 1080p @ 60 FPS gameplay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 265 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: N/A
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for stylized low-poly visuals. Runs smoothly on most mid-range PCs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
